update: {"kind": "procedure_update_v2", "procedure": "Consolidate public requests and correlated execution receipts into a compact obligation ledger in the existing memory text. Preserve for each live obligation: origin event, target, requested operation, activation or continuation condition, current ordering and revision event, status, and latest correlated receipt. Record conditional future work as authorized but waiting for its stated condition, not unauthorized. Distinguish authorization from readiness and completion. Carry forward the originating authorization and continuation trigger across unrelated intervening work. A short continuation request need not repeat the original authorization. Remove an obligation only on an explicit applicable cancellation or a receipt proving its requested extent complete. One successful segment leaves the remainder pending when the request requires more. A submitted action is only a commitment until the correlated receipt. A revision changes only its stated scope; retain the original ordering needed to resolve relative references. Before saving, check each previously pending or conditional obligation: either retain it with its trigger, or cite the cancellation/completion event that discharges it. Never turn an actor assumption about authorization into a user restriction. Preserve unresolved conflicts as uncertain. Within the shared memory budget prioritize live obligations and evidence IDs over coordinates or verbose completed-job descriptions; compact discharged jobs. Do not invent a plan, task, restriction, dependency or completion. History records the actual change and its evidence."}
